name: Mupsi Shacklefridd
summary: Outside Ratchet in the Barrens, Mupsi Shacklefridd helps travelers repair ties with the Steamwheedle Cartel.

sections.title: On the Outskirts of Ratchet
sections.body: Mupsi Shacklefridd works along the coastal road just outside Ratchet. Steamwheedle guards patrol the port town's edge as merchants come and go. Travelers on poor terms with the goblins can seek a way back into the cartel's good graces through Mupsi, if they bring the supplies and labor it demands.

faq.answer: Mupsi Shacklefridd is a goblin stationed just outside Ratchet in the Barrens. She helps travelers restore their standing with the Steamwheedle Cartel.
You can find Mupsi just outside Ratchet in the Barrens, where port guards and patrols sometimes pass by.

faq.q: Why would someone talk to Mupsi Shacklefridd?
faq.answer: If you have angered the Steamwheedle Cartel, Mupsi can help you repair your reputation with supplies. This often follows trouble with goblins or siding with pirates.
